scope: Smoother first-time Chrome and email setup, and easier voice options.

topics.title: Email helps you add your first account
details: If no email account is set up, opening Email now starts adding one.
Choose Thunderbird or Yahoo by voice, by letter, or with the arrows and Enter.

topics.title: Choose your voice in Voice options
details: The voice list is now first in Voice options. It shows the voices of the synthesizer in use.
Synthesizer options is where you pick SAPI, eSpeak, or an AI voice.

topics.title: Back to Companion after Chrome setup
details: Once you turn on the extension in Chrome, Companion comes back to the front by itself.
The Web browser menu is ready for your keys. You do not need Alt+Tab.

topics.title: No surprise web pages
details: Chrome setup now opens Chrome on a blank page.
Pages you set to open when Chrome starts no longer open during setup.

topics.title: Up Arrow raises the value
details: In Voice options, Up Arrow now raises speech rate, voice pitch, and volume. Down Arrow lowers them.
